q1_林后 6:14-18.text: 你们和不信的原不相配，不要同负一轭。义和不义有甚么相交呢？光明和黑暗有甚么相通呢？基督和彼列（彼列就是撒但的别名）有甚么相和呢？信主的和不信主的有甚么相干呢？神的殿和偶像有甚么相同呢？因为我们是永生神的殿，就如神曾说：我要在他们中间居住，在他们中间来往；我要作他们的神；他们要作我的子民。又说：你们务要从他们中间出来，与他们分别；不要沾不洁净的物，我就收纳你们。我要作你们的父；你们要作我的儿女。这是全能的主说的。
q1_林后 6:14-18.ccb: 你们和不信的原不相配，不要同负一轭。义和不义有什么相交呢？光明和黑暗有什么相通呢？
q1_林后 6:14-18.csb: 你们不可与不信的人同负一轭。公义和罪恶到底有什么相通呢？光明与黑暗有什么相合呢？
q1_林后 6:14-18.esv: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness? What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever? What agreement is there between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: I will live with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people. Therefore, Come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you. And, I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

q2_林前 5:11.text: 但如今我写信给你们说，若有称为弟兄是行淫乱的，或贪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱骂的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，这样的人不可与他相交，就是与他吃饭都不可。
q2_林前 5:11.ccb: 但如今我写信给你们说，若有称为弟兄是行淫乱的，或贪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱骂的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，这样的人不可与他相交，就是与他吃饭都不可。
q2_林前 5:11.csb: 5:11 But actually, I wrote you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother or sister and is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or verbally abusiv...
q2_林前 5:11.esv: But now I am writing to you that you must not associate with anyone who claims to be a brother or sister but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or slanderer, a drunkard or swindler. Do not even eat with such people.

q3_约一 3:14.text: 我们因为爱弟兄，就晓得是已经出死入生了。没有爱心的，仍住在死中。
q3_约一 3:14.ccb: 我们因为爱弟兄，就晓得是已经出死入生了。没有爱心的，仍住在死中。
q3_约一 3:14.csb: 3:14 We know that we have passed from death to life because we love our brothers and sisters. The one who does not love remains in death.
q3_约一 3:14.esv: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. Whoever does not love abides in death.

q4_太 18:21-22.text: 那时，彼得进前来，对耶稣说：主阿，我弟兄得罪我，我当饶恕他几次呢？到七次可以么？耶稣说：我对你说，不是到七次，乃是到七十个七次。
q4_太 18:21-22.ccb: 那时，彼得进前来问耶稣：“主啊，如果我的弟兄得罪了我，我要饶恕他多少次呢？七次够吗？”耶稣回答说：“我告诉你，不是七次，是七十个七次。
q4_太 18:21-22.csb: 那时， 彼得 前来问耶稣：“主啊，如果弟兄对我犯罪，我该饶恕多少次呢？到七次可以吗？” 耶稣对他说：“我告诉你：不是七次，而是七十个七次。
q4_太 18:21-22.esv: Then Peter came up and said to him, "Lord, how often will my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? As many as seven times?" Jesus said to him, "I do not say to you seven times, but seventy-seven times.

q5_约 17:23.text: 我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全的合而为一，叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。
q5_约 17:23.ccb: 我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全地合而为一，叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。
q5_约 17:23.csb: I am in them and you are in me, so that they may be made completely one, that the world may know you have sent me and have loved them as you have loved me.
q5_约 17:23.esv: I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.

q6_腓 2:3-4.text: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
q6_腓 2:3-4.ccb: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
q6_腓 2:3-4.csb: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility consider others as more important than yourselves.Everyone should look not to his own interests, but rather to the interests of others.
q6_腓 2:3-4.esv: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves, not looking to your own interests but each of you to the interests of the others.

q7_约一 1:5.text: 神就是光，在他毫无黑暗。这是我们从主所听见、又报给你们的信息。
q7_约一 1:5.ccb: 神就是光，在他毫无黑暗。这是我们从主所听见、又报给你们的信息。
q7_约一 1:5.csb: 1:5 This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light, and there is absolutely no darkness in him.
q7_约一 1:5.esv: This is the message we have heard from him and proclaim to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

q8_约一 1:6.text: 我们若说是与神相交，却仍在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了。
q8_约一 1:6.ccb: 我们若说是与　神相交，却仍在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了。
q8_约一 1:6.csb: 1:6 If we say, “We have fellowship with him,” and yet we walk in darkness, we are lying and are not practicing the truth.
q8_约一 1:6.esv: If we say we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

q9_约一 3:11.text: 我们应当彼此相爱。这就是你们从起初所听见的命令。
q9_约一 3:11.ccb: 我们应当彼此相爱。这就是你们从起初所听见的命令。
q9_约一 3:11.csb: 3:11 For this is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another,
q9_约一 3:11.esv: For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

q10_约一 2:9-11.text: 人若说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄，他到如今还是在黑暗里。爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他并没有绊跌的缘由。惟独恨弟兄的，是在黑暗里，且在黑暗里行，也不知道往那里去，因为黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
q10_约一 2:9-11.ccb: 人若说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄，他到如今还是在黑暗里。爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他并没有绊跌的缘由。惟独恨弟兄的，是在黑暗里，且在黑暗里行，也不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
q10_约一 2:9-11.csb: 2:9 The one who says he is in the light but hates his brother or sister is in the darkness until now.2:10 The one who loves his brother or sister remains in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him.2:11 But the one who hates his brother or sister is in the darkness, walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he’s going, because the darkness has blinded hi...
q10_约一 2:9-11.esv: Whoever says he is in the light and hates his brother is still in darkness. Whoever loves his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling. But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

q11_约一 3:7-10.text: 小子们哪，不要被人诱感，行义的才是义人，正如主是义的一样。犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。凡从神生的，就不犯罪，因神的道（原文作种）存在他心里；他也不能犯罪，因为他是由神生的。从此就显出谁是神的儿女，。谁是魔鬼的儿女。凡不行义的就不属神，不爱弟兄的也是如此。
q11_约一 3:7-10.ccb: 小子们哪，不要被人诱惑。行义的才是义人，正如主是义的一样。犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。　神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。凡从　神生的，就不犯罪，因　神的道（原文作“种”）存在他心里；他也不能犯罪，因为他是由　神生的。从此就显出谁是　神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女。凡不行义的就不属　神，不爱弟兄的也是如此。
q11_约一 3:7-10.csb: 3:7 Little children, let no one deceive you. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.3:8 The one who commits sin is of the devil, for the devil has sinned from the beginning. The Son of God was revealed for this purpose: to destroy the devil’s wo...3:9 Everyone who has been born of God does not sin, because his seed remains in him; he is not able to sin, because he has been born of God.3:10 This is how God’s children and the devil’s children become obvious. Whoever does not do what is right is not of God, especially the one who does not love his...
q11_约一 3:7-10.esv: Little children, let no one deceive you. Whoever practices righteousness is righteous, as he is righteous. Whoever makes a practice of sinning is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the works of the devil. No one born of God makes a practice of sinning, for God’s seed abides in him, and he cannot keep on sinning because he has been born of God. By this it is evident who are the children of God, and who are the children of the devil: whoever does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is the one who does not love his brother.

q12_约一 4:20.text: 人若说我爱神，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的；不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的神（有古卷作：怎能爱没有看见的神呢）。
q12_约一 4:20.ccb: 人若说“我爱　神”，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的；不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的　神（有古卷作“怎能爱没有看见的　神呢？”）。
q12_约一 4:20.csb: 4:20 If anyone says, “I love God,” and yet hates his brother or sister, he is a liar. For the person who does not love his brother or sister whom he has seen cann...
q12_约一 4:20.esv: If anyone says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.

q13_林前 6:18-20.text: 你们要逃避淫行。人所犯的，无论甚么罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿么？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里头的；并且你们不是自己的人；因为你们是重价买来的。所以，要在你们的身子上荣耀神。
q13_林前 6:18-20.ccb: 你们要逃避淫行。人所犯的，无论什么罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从　神而来，住在你们里头的；并且你们不是自己的人，因为你们是重价买来的。所以，要在你们的身子上荣耀　神。
q13_林前 6:18-20.csb: 6:18 Flee sexual immorality! Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the person who is sexually immoral sins against his own body.6:19 Don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,6:20 for you were bought at a price. So glorify God with your body.
q13_林前 6:18-20.esv: Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a person commits are outside the body, but whoever sins sexually, sins against their own body. Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

q14_诗 119:11.text: 我将你的话藏在心里，免得我得罪你。
q14_诗 119:11.ccb: 我把你的话藏在心里，免得我得罪你。
q14_诗 119:11.csb: 我将你的话语珍藏在我心里，免得我得罪你。
q14_诗 119:11.esv: I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

q15_雅 5:16.text: 所以你们要彼此认罪，互相代求，使你们可以得医治。义人祈祷所发的力量是大有功效的。
q15_雅 5:16.ccb: 所以，你们要彼此认罪，互相代祷，以便得到医治。义人的祷告有极大的力量和功效。
q15_雅 5:16.csb: 所以你们当彼此认罪，彼此代求，好使你们得痊愈。义人所做的祈祷是大有力量的。
q15_雅 5:16.esv: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.
